lines.t: Come here, you nations, here, oh earth, let every living thing take heed.
The fury of the Lord is rising
Against the armies of the earth
His indignation falls like fire
On every nation under the sky
The slain will lie unburied
Their stench will rise into the air
Mountains will melt beneath the blood
And no one will be spared
The heavens will be rolled like a scroll
The stars will fall like leaves in the wind
The sword of the Lord is drawn in heaven
And judgment is coming near
This is the day of the Lord's vengeance
The year of recompense for Zion
The sword is spilled, the land will drink
And nothing will remain the same
The streams will turn to burning pitch
Dust will become brimstone and flame
Smoke will rise from age to age
And no one will pass through again
The wild ox and the mighty bull
Will fall beside the lambs and rats
The land of the cursed will be soaked
Its dust made fat with judgment
Bozrah will become a slaughter
The people of the curse will fall, the sword will bathe itself in blood until the work is finished.
This is the day of the Lord's vengeance, the year of recompense for Zion.
The sword is filled, the land will drink, and nothing will remain the same.
Screams will turn to burning pitch
Dust will become brimstone and flame
Smoke will rise from age to age
And no one will pass through again
Thorns will climb the empty palaces
Nettles will claim the broken walls
Jackals will howl in the courtyards
Ostriches will cry through the halls
The owl and the raven will dwell there
The porcupine and pelican will stay
The night creature will find her rest
And the hawk will gather with her mate
Search the book and you will see
Not one of these will fail to come
The mouth of the Lord has spoken
It is spirit has already gathered them
This is the day of the Lord's vengeance
The year of recompense for Zion
The sword is filled, the land will drink
And nothing will remain the same
Streams will turn to burning pitch
Dust will become brimstone and flame
Smoke will rise from age to age
And no one will pass through again
He has cast the law
His hand has measured the ground
From generation to generation
They will dwell
And what He has judged
